update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.29 - Momentum racing, training gates, and the full scenario-overrides port
Added ----- - Momentum Race Selection (Racing Settings, off by default): adapts optional-race pickiness to how the run is going. On a losing streak the bot raises its win-chance bar and trains/recovers instead of taking marginal races (this works even with the win-rate guard otherwise off); on a winning streak it takes slightly riskier races, but only while a fan goal is still unmet - once fans are covered it always protects training turns. - Retry Unity Cup Races (Racing Settings, off by default): tap Try Again on a lost Unity Cup race instead of accepting the loss. Independently of the toggle, a lost race's Try Again dialog is now always handled - previously it stalled the race loop until a 30-second "Race event took too long" abort. - Minimum Energy to Train (Training Settings, 0 = off): below this energy a training turn becomes a rest turn. Applies after Smart Race Solver plans and energy banking; skipped during Finals. - Wit Maximum Failure Chance (Training Settings, 0 = follow global): give Wit training its own failure-chance ceiling, since a failed Wit attempt costs no energy. - Wit Over Rest (Training Settings, shown when the energy floor is set): when the floor triggers, try Wit training before resting - only if Wit passes the failure-chance filters, otherwise the bot still rests. - Unity Cup scenario overrides: Extreme Burst Minimum Stat Gain (only prioritize an Extreme Spirit Burst when the facility's projected main-stat gain is high enough) and Burst Only Top 3 Stats After Junior (post-Junior, burst priority only for your top 3 prioritized stats). - URA Finale scenario override: Happy Meek Duel Bias (Off/Moderate/Aggressive) - detects the Duel badge on a training facility and steers training toward it so the bot enters and wins the duel.
Fixed ----- - Training failure-chance reads no longer burn all their retries in a quarter second while the game is still re-rendering after a server "Connecting" round-trip, which could skip a whole turn's training analysis. - The Scenario Overrides page now shows each campaign its own sections. Previously it rendered the full Trackblazer section set for every campaign, and the Unity Cup Burst Failure-Chance Exemption slider had displaced the Trackblazer "Irregular Training Minimum Stat Gain" slider (with the wrong description).
